    AI Overview
    Former NBA star Carlos Boozer has four children across two marriages:
    oldest son Carmani, twins Cameron and Cayden, and youngest daughter Bloom. His twins, Cameron and Cayden Boozer, are high-profile basketball players for Duke University, famously born to help cure their older brother's sickle cell disease. 
    Key Details About Carlos Boozer's Children: 
    • Carmani Boozer: Carlos's oldest son, who plays baseball and was diagnosed with sickle cell disease at a young age.
    • Cameron & Cayden Boozer (Twins): Born in 2007, they are standout basketball players at Duke University, their father's alma mater. They are considered elite 2025 NBA draft prospects.
    • The "Life-Saving" Birth: Cameron and Cayden were born via IVF, allowing doctors to select healthy embryos that were also a genetic match to cure their older brother, Carmani, of sickle cell disease using stem cells from their umbilical cord.
    • Bloom Boozer: Carlos's youngest daughter, born in 2019 with his second wife, Aneshka Smith. 
    Carlos Boozer, along with the twins' mother, CeCe Boozer, is actively involved in supporting their basketball careers, says People.com.
